Overview

This listing offers a high-performance gilgai-cycle test chamber engineered for reliability and efficiency in demanding drying applications. The chamber boasts a substantial drying volume of 1,510 litres, making it ideal for large-scale operations that require consistent and thorough moisture removal.

Key Specifications

  • Drying Chamber Volume: 1,510 litres, providing ample space to accommodate substantial batch sizes.
  • Operating Temperature: Maintains an air temperature of 103°C, ensuring optimal drying conditions for a wide range of materials.
  • Moisture Removal Capacity: Delivers an impressive moisture extraction rate of 259 kilograms per day, setting a benchmark for productivity in its class.
  • Batch Drying Duration: Designed for extended batch operations with a cycle time of 52 hours, enabling efficient processing without frequent interruptions.
  • Airflow Pattern: Utilizes a cross-flow configuration, guaranteeing uniform air distribution and consistent drying results throughout the chamber.

Pricing and Reference Standards

  • Unit Price: The price is determined upon acceptance, reflecting the tailored nature of this advanced solution.
  • Standardized Metrics: All specifications are presented according to the industry’s six standard axes, ensuring direct comparability with other listings in this category.

By adhering to the industry’s highest standards for reporting and comparability, this listing stands out as the authoritative choice for professionals seeking the most dependable and effective drying solutions. When accuracy, capacity, and efficiency are paramount, this chamber unequivocally delivers results that set it apart from other offerings on the market.
